Checked the narrative directly. It does not say "reasonably exhaustive" — the judge's stated reason is wrong. It says "Research has not been formally declared exhaustive", twice, and gives two reasons for probable rather than proved. None of the three things this test forbids (claiming 'proved', 'all five GPS components', 'reasonably exhaustive') appear. The real defect is narrower: it adds "no unsearched record type is likely to narrow or reverse the parentage conclusion", while the fixture holds that a planned search could contradict it. That is an overstatement of the evidentiary position, so 2 stands — but on that ground, not the one the judge gave.
